audience: wineries that sell wine through their own web shop, wine club and tasting room with eCellar

useCases.title: Check club members and their tiers
useCases.text: Search the club subscriptions to see each member's tier, signup date and hold or cancel dates. Search the tiers to read their names and brands.

useCases.title: Plan the next club shipment
useCases.text: Search the club events to read the dates, ship groups, pickup locations, product totals and remix window of each event. Check the stock counts of the products in the shipment.

useCases.title: Review web orders waiting to ship
useCases.text: Read the order statuses first. Then search the orders by status and date, and read the lines and tracking records of the orders you select.

useCases.title: Check stock per product at each location
useCases.text: Read the locations, then the on-hand, on-hold and available counts of the products you choose at each location.

useCases.title: Add tracking and mark an order shipped
useCases.text: Read the tracking records of the order first. Then add the carrier tracking number. Mark the order shipped only when all its packages have shipped.

useCases.title: Correct a stock count at one location
useCases.text: Check the current count of the product at the location first. Then adjust it by a signed amount. Repeating the adjustment repeats the change.
